scenarios.name: non-kree-creature-counter-is-copied
scenarios.why: Experiment One gains a +1/+1 counter when the larger Grizzly Bears enters. It is another creature and not a Kree, so Captain Marvel's intervening condition is true and it gets a matching counter.

scenarios.name: equal-creature-enters-without-counter-no-trigger
scenarios.why: The equal-sized Llanowar Elves entering does not cause the existing Experiment One to gain a counter, so there is no counter-putting event for Captain Marvel to trigger on.
